soundness_flags.label: thm:fixed-a-endpoint-frontier
soundness_flags.one_line: Its arrowhead iff fails in Dai's basic regime: if v→u is a basal edge with u (and hence v) ancestrally selected but regime k targets an unrelated vertex, Lemma 6 retains v→u in M_k, so the arrowhead at u is feasible in η itself although u∉Z_k.

soundness_flags.label: def:calculus-handle / oeq:selection-lifting
soundness_flags.one_line: The stipulated handle propagates along L_{A(η)}, but A(η) is unobserved and the OEQ simultaneously prohibits guessing A; no observable certificate replacing that premise is specified.

source_verification_receipts.locator: pp. 7–8, Lemmas 4–6 and Theorem 3; p. 8, completeness discussion; p. 10, conclusion
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: Lemma 5 identifies ζ-adjacency as direct targeting or indirect effect plus ancestral selection; Lemma 6 retains a basal directed MAG edge Xi→Xj as Xi→Xj in the intervention MAG; the paper proves CDIS soundness and says its completeness and equivalence-class representation remain open.

source_verification_receipts.locator: p. 1, abstract; pp. 1–2, Introduction; p. 6, Definition 7
source_verification_receipts.verified_claim: The paper studies unknown-target soft interventions with latent variables, defines ψ-Markov equivalence, and states a sound-and-complete learner; its model is a graph-and-target pair rather than a pre-treatment selected common-basal twin model.

The paper gives polynomial-delay MAG listing by recursively introducing supplied singleton background knowledge and locally complete rules, while noting incompleteness for general background knowledge.
The paper models post-treatment selection, introduces FI-Markov equivalence and F-PAG, and states that F-FCI is sound and complete for that setting.

strengthening_paths.suggestion: Replace the fixed-A frontier with a formula that includes retained basal directed orientations, or restrict it to the precisely defined class of intervention-created selected adjacencies; prove the Dai Lemma-6 sanity reduction before using it in the lifting kernel.

Rewrite the calculus handle so every path premise is a predicate of the observable full signature plus explicitly defined local selectedness certificates; L_A may appear only in an existential witness proof, never as a rule premise.
After repair, add a small explicit selected DAG with an unrelated intervention that exercises each endpoint case in the frontier and demonstrates that the proposed closure input is observable.

recommended_next_step: Reject the current core and redraft the fixed-A frontier and observable rule handle before resubmitting the field-tier completeness kernel.
